encounter.title: Prologue Boss — Square Candidate A (8x8 seed 388)

phases.label: moved to North (↑): Rotate granted, interrupt cast!

encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate A. 8x8 seed 388 (16 arrows: N1 E5 S2 W8). Phase 1 boss on E (4 hp, int 6 dmg 1). Phase 2 boss on N (5 hp, CAST IN 3 dmg 1, interruptible -> normal int 4 dmg 1). Teaches directional scarcity and wrong Rotate: board has only 1 N arrow. Phase 1 consumes 4 of 5 E arrows. Rotate CW converts 8 W arrows into N arrows for a clean 0-damage kill. Rotate CCW converts the depleted E arrows into N (insufficient ammo), taking 2 unavoidable damage.
